Home/Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

How this site collects, uses and protects the information you share. Effective November 1, 2026.

Who We Are

findhomesarounddenver.com is operated by Chris Nowakiwsky, Broker Associate with The Real Estate Experts at RE/MAX Professionals, 10111 Inverness Main St, Suite P, Englewood, CO 80112. Each RE/MAX office is independently owned and operated. In this policy, "we," "us" and "our" refer to Chris Nowakiwsky.

Information We Collect

We only collect information you choose to give us through the forms on this site:

  • Home value requests: your name, email, optional phone number, property address and selling timeline.
  • Contact requests: your name, email, optional phone number, what you're interested in and your message.
  • Guide downloads: your name and email, and which guide you downloaded.

Our hosting provider also records standard technical information when you visit, such as your IP address, browser type and the pages requested, to deliver and secure the site. We don't use advertising trackers or sell any data.

How We Use Your Information

  • To respond to your request, such as preparing a home valuation or answering a question.
  • To follow up by email, phone or text about your real estate plans, if you've given us that contact information.
  • To send occasional market updates or helpful information. You can opt out at any time.

We don't sell, rent or trade your personal information. We may share it with a lender, title company or other service provider only when you ask us to connect you, or when it's needed to complete a transaction you're part of.

Service Providers

This site is hosted by Netlify, which processes form submissions and delivers them to us by email. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which means your browser requests them from Google's servers. These providers handle data under their own privacy policies.

Cookies

This site doesn't use advertising or tracking cookies. If we add analytics in the future, we'll update this policy.

Your Choices

You can ask us at any time to stop contacting you, or to update or delete the information you've shared. Email chris.nowakiwsky@remax.net or call (970) 485-2228, and we'll take care of it promptly.

Children's Privacy

This site is intended for adults. We don't knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.

Changes to This Policy

If we change this policy, we'll post the updated version here with a new effective date.

Contact

Questions about this policy? Contact Chris Nowakiwsky at chris.nowakiwsky@remax.net or (970) 485-2228.
